d: bhavsagar ke thaperon se santapt aur sukh dukh ke bandhnon men bhatakta agyani manav jab shraddha bhakti purvak man ganga ki sharan leta hai to uske samast pap nasht ho jate hain sansar ke aakarshan bhare pralobhnon se munh mor kar jab manushy sachche man se bhagavti bhagirthi ka aashray leta hai to uska antarbahy jivan nirmal pavan ban jata hai aisi hai vardani aur kalyanamyi man ganga
